annotations.title: MRR Bridge and Net Revenue Retention

description: Explain how monthly recurring revenue (MRR) moved between two subscription snapshots. Send each customer's MRR at the start and at the end (customer code and amount), and mark customers at the end who had paid before the start snapshot but were at 0 in it (returning). Get back the MRR bridge: starting MRR, new, reactivation, expansion, contraction, churn and ending MRR, with the customer count for each movement, net and gross revenue retention, logo churn, the quick ratio, and the movement for every customer. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/mrr-bridge). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

end.description: End snapshot: each customer's MRR (up to 200; a customer missing here is read as 0).

customer.description: Your customer code or billing-system customer ID, e.g. a Stripe cus_ ID (matched without regard to case, echoed as you sent it; up to 12 digits in a row; web addresses and phone, Social Security or card shapes are refused). Not a person's name or email.

mrr.description: Monthly recurring revenue for this customer in the snapshot (0 if none).

returning.description: true if this customer paid before the start snapshot but had 0 MRR in it (counts as reactivation, not new). A customer at 0 at the start and above 0 at the end counts as new unless marked returning.

end_date.description: Optional: date of the end snapshot.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'Oct 2026' (your own text, echoed).

start.description: Start snapshot: each customer's MRR (up to 200; an empty list for a business with no customers yet).

customer.description: Your customer code or billing-system customer ID, e.g. a Stripe cus_ ID (matched without regard to case, echoed as you sent it; up to 12 digits in a row; web addresses and phone, Social Security or card shapes are refused). Not a person's name or email.

mrr.description: Monthly recurring revenue for this customer in the snapshot (0 if none).

start_date.description: Optional: date of the start snapshot (echoed; the bridge covers the span between the two snapshots).

name: mrr_bridge
title: MRR Bridge and Net Revenue Retention
